message: So, there I was, enjoying a cozy evening when suddenly—boom! The lights went out. My first thought? "Great, I can finally finish that book I've been meaning to read..." until I realized I couldn’t find my flashlight. I ended up rummaging through drawers in the dark like a raccoon on a mission. 🤦‍♀️ In the end, my phone battery saved the day (thank you, power bank!). Lesson learned: always have a flashlight handy and keep those devices charged! What’s your go-to tip for staying ready during a blackout?
